simple.meaning: חֹסֶן (chôçen) is a Hebrew object word meaning “wealth.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Proverbs 15:6. The surrounding context includes righteousness, kingship, prophetic witness, city.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חֹסֶן (H2633) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: חֹסֶן (chôçen) / H2633 is traced through Proverbs 15:6, Proverbs 27:24, Isaiah 33:6, Jeremiah 20:5 with generated occurrence evidence.

timeline.evidenceText: In the house of the righteous is much treasure,
There will be stability in your times, abundance of salvation, wisdom, and knowledge.

Moreover I will give all the riches of this city, and all its gains, and all its precious things, yes, I will give all the treasures of the kings of Judah into the hand of their enemies. They will make them captives, take them, and carry them to Babylon.
There is a conspiracy of her prophets within it, like a roaring lion ravening the prey. They have devoured souls. They take treasure and precious things. They have made many widows within it.
